title: AnswerSheet
description: A question navigator (答题卡) for practice and exam sessions: numbered pills grouped by section, each showing whether the question is unanswered, answered, correct, wrong or skipped, with a flag for review and the current question highlighted.

support.notes: Numbered question pills grouped by section with unanswered/answered/correct/wrong/skipped statuses, flag dot, controlled/uncontrolled current question (aria-current=step), wrap/scroll layouts, fixed columns, translated item labels, summary and legend, and two sizes. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. H5 supports arrow keys and Home/End across the pills (disabled pills are skipped; no row-wise ArrowUp/ArrowDown); native hosts use tap selection. layout=scroll centres the current pill through the ScrollView scrollLeft, measured with createSelectorQuery after each change. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: AnswerSheet
translationResources.description: A question navigator (答题卡) for practice and exam sessions: numbered pills grouped by section, each showing whether the question is unanswered, answered, correct, wrong or skipped, with a flag for review and the current question highlighted.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A controlled current question (value / onChange). The sheet is a nav landmark of buttons; the current pill carries aria-current="step". One tab stop: the arrow keys and Home / End move the focus, Enter / Space select.

groups.title: Sections, statuses and legend
groups.description: groups titles the sections (items render under the group whose key matches item.group, numbered across sections). Statuses: answered, correct, wrong, skipped; flagged adds a warning dot. showSummary counts the answered questions and showLegend explains the statuses present.

scroll.title: Scrolling row
scroll.description: layout="scroll" keeps a single horizontally scrolling row, for a compact navigator above the question.

sizes.title: Sizes, columns and disabled
sizes.description: Two pill sizes, a fixed grid with columns (ArrowUp / ArrowDown move by a row; without columns they move to the nearest pill of the row above / below), and a disabled sheet.

AnswerSheetProps.groups: Titled sections, in display order; items render under the group whose key matches item.group
AnswerSheetProps.value: Key of the current question (controlled; pair with onChange)
AnswerSheetProps.defaultValue: Key of the initially current question (uncontrolled)
AnswerSheetProps.onChange: Called with the key of the selected question
AnswerSheetProps.layout: "wrap" wraps the pills on several rows; "scroll" keeps a single horizontally scrolling row
AnswerSheetProps.columns: Fixed number of columns (a grid; ArrowUp / ArrowDown move by a row). Ignored with layout="scroll".
AnswerSheetProps.showLegend: Shows a legend of the statuses present (and of the flag)
AnswerSheetProps.showSummary: Shows the number of answered questions ("12 / 20 answered")
AnswerSheetProps.getItemLabel: Accessible name of a pill; receives the item and its display index
AnswerSheetProps.aria-label: Accessible name of the navigation landmark
AnswerSheetProps.className: Additional class of the root element

AnswerSheetItem.key: Unique key of the question (the value of the sheet)
AnswerSheetItem.label: Visible label of the pill (defaults to its number across all the groups)
AnswerSheetItem.status: Status of the question: unanswered, answered, correct, wrong or skipped
AnswerSheetItem.flagged: Flags the question for review (a warning dot in a corner)
AnswerSheetItem.group: Key of its group; items without a known group render first, in an untitled section

cssVars.--answer-sheet-gap: Space between the pills (defaults to --space-2; --space-1-5 with size="small")
cssVars.--answer-sheet-item-size: Minimum width and height of a pill (defaults to 2rem; 1.75rem with size="small")
cssVars.--answer-sheet-radius: Corner radius of the pills (defaults to --radius-md)
cssVars.--answer-sheet-answered-background: Background of an answered pill (defaults to --primary-color-subtle)
cssVars.--answer-sheet-answered-color: Text color of an answered pill
cssVars.--answer-sheet-correct-background: Background of a correct pill (defaults to --success-color-subtle)
cssVars.--answer-sheet-correct-color: Text color of a correct pill
cssVars.--answer-sheet-wrong-background: Background of a wrong pill (defaults to --danger-color-subtle)
cssVars.--answer-sheet-wrong-color: Text color of a wrong pill
cssVars.--answer-sheet-current-background: Background of the current pill (defaults to --primary-color)
cssVars.--answer-sheet-current-color: Text color of the current pill
cssVars.--answer-sheet-flag-color: Color of the flag dot (defaults to --warning-color)
cssVars.--answer-sheet-title-color: Text color of the group titles and the summary

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: items is a property; value (the key of the current question) is an attribute and minerva-change reports the selected key. One tab stop: the arrow keys and Home / End move the focus, Enter / Space select.

groups.title: Sections, statuses and legend
groups.description: The groups property titles the sections; show-summary and show-legend add the answered count and a legend of the statuses present. Pills expose ::part(item item--status-wrong), item--flagged, item--current ...

scroll.title: Scrolling row
scroll.description: layout="scroll" keeps a single horizontally scrolling row (also the :state(layout-scroll) custom state).

sizes.title: Sizes, columns and disabled
sizes.description: size="small", a fixed grid with columns="5" (ArrowUp / ArrowDown move by a row) and a disabled sheet.

events.minerva-change: The user selected a question (detail: { value }, its key).

methods.focus: Focuses the pill holding the tab stop.
